clinicalUse: Non-diagnostic conceptual graphic, not to scale and not a patient image.
purpose: Illustrate the progression used in the lumbar Lee MRI grading: preserved perineural fat, fat obliteration in one opposing axis, obliteration in both axes without root deformation, and root deformation.
sourceBasis: Lee et al. Korean J Radiol 2023;24:224-234. DOI 10.3348/kjr.2022.0351.
localization: No language-specific text is embedded in the SVG; translated alt text and the adjacent table provide the localized explanation.
reviewStatus: Independent visual review passed on 2026-10-23; conceptual, non-diagnostic scope confirmed.
